pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*

fun main() {
    val result = Xberg.pdfPageCount(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Paths.get("pdf/sample_contract.pdf")), null)
    println(result)
}
```
